purpose: Design of target resolution, DLID embedding, and ToC build: argument validation, scope expansion, ID checks, change sets, candidate confirmation, write units, and rerun behavior.
summary: Inputs, outputs and execution boundary of a build; builds never rewrite index target documents
Argument rules and expansion of paths, directories, patterns and excludes, with fixed exclusions, normalization, symlinks and Markdown detection
Documents without an ID or with duplicate IDs are excluded and reported while the build continues
DLID embedding operation: explicit start, counts-only result, duplicate origin confirmation, section ID issuing, rollback rules
DLID issuing spec: 60-bit random Crockford Base32, 12 characters, probabilistic uniqueness
Change set determination: new, left scope, path change, content hash change, and section-level add, delete, move, heading and body change
Information acquisition: reuse unchanged document information, AI generates only needed info, script validates, candidate checks
Write units: atomic os.replace for document information and ToC, no locking
Reference check results are recorded, not failures; completion and rerun re-evaluate from confirmed ToC and files
tasks: Implementing target expansion and argument validation for build or embed-dlid
Implementing DLID embedding and section ID issuing
Implementing ToC build and change detection
Designing atomic writes and failure recovery
Writing tests for scope expansion and build
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
